14 Troubleshooting

Arranged by what you are seeing. Work down the list.

What changes the light

These are the actions that change what the lights do. Check them before you touch anything during a show.

ActionWhat changesAsks first
Recalling a Scene — a row, BACK / NEXT, Play, STAGE, MIDI or a keyThe look, over the Scene's fade. Not GM, B.O. or ⏻No
REVERTThe current Scene, then the light, over its fadeYes, Revert Scene?
Opening another show, or a new oneEverythingYes (chapter 11)
Importing a showNothing until you open itYes (chapter 11)
Restore under VersionsThe whole showYes
A row in HISTORY, UNDO, REDOBack to that stateNo
B.O., GM, a group masterEvery fixture they cover, except locked onesNo
BATTERY SAVEThe marked fixturesNo
Unlocking a fixtureIt goes to the values Kanau is working outNo
Turning a universe back ONThat universe starts sending againNo
Slide to send, Slide to stopAll outputThe slide is the check

Nothing lights up

Look at these four first.

What you seeWhat to do
OUTPUT OFF / Not sentNothing has been sent since Kanau opened. A red Not sent means the light changed while nothing was sent. Tap it and slide (chapter 02)
B.O.Tap it to clear the blackout. When GM is at 0 it also reads B.O., and a tap opens the GM panel instead
GM 0Open GM and use BACK TO 100
An amber BLIND at the top leftYou are in BLIND, and what you do does not reach the lights. Tap it to leave

If it is still dark:

What you seeWhat to do
IdleCheck that a network is enabled in Settings → Output
BlockedTap it to open Settings → Output, which prints a red line that names what stopped it and what to do. Follow that line
Blocked U1, with a universe numberAnother sender is already on that universe. Tap it for Join, Send … Only or Cancel
No nodeTap it to open Settings → Output. Check the node's power, network, address and protocol settings
U1 OFFTurn the universe back on in Output → Universes
A purple ⏻ or fixture iconTurn the fixture's output back on
A green BATTERY SAVE, or a shadow with a green ↓ on a faderTurn BATTERY SAVE off, or tap RELEASE in the green band of that fixture's panel
A low Upper LimitCheck the fixture's limits
⚠ in PatchFix the overlapping address or the run past 512
A mode that does not matchSet the same DMX mode as the fixture itself

No node is found

If Network shows No reply, check that the iPhone and the node are on the same network. If AUTO does not reach it, use UNICAST and enter the node's address. Run RESCAN after changing anything about the connection.

Check that Art-Net or sACN is turned on in the node, and check its address and its universe. For how a particular piece of gear shows this, see its own manual. Gear that does not answer polling shows 0 under Nodes Answering even while receiving.

It flickers

Check that the same fixture is not being fed from both the network and Bluetooth, or from more than one console or DMX source. Look at any SHARED or Blocked message and cut the paths down to one. The same universe number on two paths is not by itself evidence that they meet (chapter 02).

Another control app, or a setting on the fixture, can also cause it.

It stutters, or reacts slowly

Open Settings → Output and read it from the top. If you find the problem at one of these, you do not need to look further down.

Network Output   is the console sending at all
   ↓
Clock            is it jammed inside the phone
   ↓
Touch → DMX     is the trip from finger to packet slow
   ↓
Nodes Answering  is the network or the gear slow (round trip)
   ↓
Fixture          is the light itself slow
What you seeWhat to look at
Network Output is NothingDestination, network, iOS permissions
Clock over 100 msThe phone. Close panels, restart the app if you need to
Nodes answer, but a light does not respondThe address AUTO is sending to. If the node reports itself wrongly, try BROADCAST
Clock is fine but the round trip is longWi-Fi congestion, the access point, the gear, the path
The numbers are fine but the light lagsSmoothing on the fixture, its input path, another app driving it

BROADCAST helps when AUTO's destination is the problem. For other causes it will not help, and may add load.

Some faders do nothing

Check the fixture's limits, its Lock, and whether its output is on.

  • A fader that shows ON and OFF: it is set as a switch. Turn off Switch in its panel to get the fader back.
  • The bottom half feels flat: the fader curve in Kanau is linear. A dimmer curve in the fixture can make the bottom half feel flat. Check the fixture itself, or Dim curve under Channels.

On a fixture imported from GDTF, wrong intensity or color usually means the roles are wrong. Fix them in Channel Roles. To carry the fix into fixtures you patch later, edit the definition under Custom Fixtures.

A button does nothing

What you seeWhy, and what to do
A purple wash over the screenSCREEN LOCK. Drag the slider in the middle to the right
A green 🔒Clear the Fixture Lock
COLOR is graySelect a fixture
EFFECT reads N RUNNINGNothing is selected, and effects are running. Tap it for the list of them, or select fixtures
PIXELS is grayThere is no pixel fixture on the page
HISTORY is inactiveThere is nothing to go back to, a Scene is fading, you are holding a fader, or this is a guest
Play's BACK and NEXT only vibrateLet go of the fader, check that there are two or more Scenes, and on a guest ask the host to tap Allow
The number buttons do not change intensityPiano mode is on LOCK. Use ＋ −
Home under Channels is inactiveIt is already at the default
Home for Pan or Tilt does nothingIt needs a hold, not a tap
A Scene will not updateCheck MANUAL UPDATE, and Lock This Scene
A guest has no PatchChange the patch on the host
A guest cannot change anything, and the status line reads WATCH ONLYThe host taps Allow in Settings → Session

The color is wrong

What you seeWhat to check
A different color from the one you setWhether the Patch mode matches the fixture's own DMX mode
No color controls at allWhether the fixture has color. Mixed models show only the shared items (chapter 05)
The color temperature stops shortYou are at the edge of the fixture's range. It reads MIN or MAX
An imported fixture is offCheck Channel Roles (chapter 06)
White pulls green or magentaGreen / Magenta may not be at 0. The 0 button returns it to neutral

A fixture does not behave

Check first that the Patch mode matches the fixture's own. When that is wrong, intensity arrives as color and color arrives as position.

A definition imported from GDTF can have roles assigned differently from the real fixture. Correct them in Channel Roles (chapter 06). To carry the fix into future patches, edit the Custom Fixtures definition.

Check anything marked Imported data is not verified. against the real fixture.

A Scene keeps changing on its own

AUTO UPDATE is on to begin with, so anything you do after recalling a Scene is recorded back into it (chapter 08).

Switch to MANUAL UPDATE at the top of Scenes and nothing goes in until you tap UPDATE. For Scenes you want left alone whatever the mode, turn on Lock This Scene under that Scene's Settings. You can still recall them and still work the light; nothing is recorded.

A Scene will not record

What to check
MANUAL UPDATENothing goes in until you tap UPDATE under that row
Lock This SceneNothing is recorded while it is on, in either mode
You are on a guestReordering, deleting and renaming are the host's (chapter 13)
What is never storedGM, B.O., ⏻, BATTERY SAVE, Power Switch, limits, Fixture Lock and FREE (chapter 08)

The session will not connect

If a Join box gives a reason, follow it (chapter 13). If Looking for the host… will not clear, check these.

  • Both devices are on the same network. No internet is needed
  • You scanned the host's current QR code. New Code makes older codes useless, and the guest then says The host's code has changed. Scan the new code.
  • Camera access for Kanau is on in iOS Settings
  • The host shows its QR code. Until it is on Wi-Fi or a wired network it shows a line saying so instead
  • Client isolation or a firewall is not blocking device-to-device traffic
  • Every device runs the same version of Kanau

DMX can get through on a network where device-to-device traffic is blocked.

Something stays lit on blackout

Check Fixture Lock. The green 🔒 n at the top counts what is still lit. Clear the lock on those fixtures.

A lock whose fixture was deleted also stays lit. Press UNLOCK on its row in DMX Monitor.

The app quit, or the link dropped

Restarting restores the last saved show and look, and the Scene you had recalled, with output off: slide to send again. The very last changes before a quit may not be there.

What your lights do after the app or the link stops depends on the node's and the fixture's own hold-last-look settings. Check the gear if you need them to hold.

A save failed

Patch was not saved. means the save failed. Check the free space on the device, and if you can, write the current state out with Export Show File. Make sure the export finished before carrying on. Dismissing the warning with × does not mean the show was saved.

If a file cannot be read, open another show from Other Shows, Import a .kanau you exported earlier, or restore an earlier state under Versions. The file that could not be read is kept.

Checking the DMX values

Settings → DMX Monitor shows all 512 channels of each universe. It only shows them; the one thing you can do there is UNLOCK a lock whose fixture was deleted.

Glossary

On screenWhat it means
FixtureA light. The unit you patch and control
PatchRegistering a fixture's model, mode and DMX address
Universe / AddressA universe, and the channel position inside it
ModeThe fixture's DMX mode. Must match the fixture itself
Fixture NumberThe fixture's number, used by the number buttons, Fixture Sheet and command entry. Never empty
COMMANDCommand entry, opened from the Play list. Type numbers to select fixtures and set intensity
TESTThe mode that checks fixtures. Start it with START TEST at the bottom of SETUP in a fixture's panel, or under TEST MODE in Settings
GapExtra free channels between fixtures
Fixture UsageThe record of which fixtures were touched and when, kept on the device for 180 days. Opens from Settings → Settings
Group / AllA set of fixtures / every fixture
Pixel / CellA separately controllable part of one fixture
IntensityBrightness
CCTColor temperature, in kelvin
G/MThe green–magenta correction
CrossfadeThe balance between the white side and the color side
EmitterAn LED or other light source inside the fixture
Channels / DMX ChannelsWorking one DMX channel at a time
Channel RolesWhich function a channel is treated as
GM / B.O.Grand master / blackout
OUTPUT OFF / SENDINGNothing sent since Kanau opened; slide to send / those universes going out
Slide to send / Slide to stopSliding right to start / to stop sending
Lock / SCREEN LOCKHolding a fixture's DMX values at its addresses (an effect running when you lock keeps running) / stopping stray touches
Strap LockLocking the screen when the iPhone or iPad hangs upside down. Slide right to unlock
FINE / FINE+1/10 and 1/20 of the usual sensitivity
PIANOUsing the number buttons to change intensity while held
Scene / ShowA stored look / everything for one job
SNAP / FadeImmediate / over a set time
DelayHow long a Scene, or one fixture in it, waits after the recall before it moves
PlayThe tab that opens a list of PLAY (on iPhone, turns the bottom row into EXIT, UPDATE, BACK and NEXT), COMMAND, ZEN, STAGE and FIXTURE SHEET
LIGHT / MOVE / GRADIENT / SETUPThe tabs of a fixture panel: intensity and color / position and beam / intensity and color laid across fixtures / names, Fade Time and fixture settings
BACK TO 100The button that puts a master back to 100
REVERTReturning a Scene to how it was when you recalled it
FREEA fixture left where it is by Scene recalls
S-CURVE / EASE IN / LINEARHow a Scene's fade moves
HISTORY / HEREThe list of earlier states / where you are in it
PAUSE / RESUMEFreezing an effect / carrying on from there
RELEASE / STARTStopping an effect / running an effect from the beginning. RELEASE in the green BATTERY SAVE band takes one fixture out of BATTERY SAVE for now
ROLESWhich lights take which color in BEACON R/B
BLINDWorking on a copy of the look that does not reach the lights, then storing it in a Scene
SwitchIn a fixture's panel, turning its fader into an ON / OFF switch. In MIDI, Switch N is the ⏻ under Fader N
VersionsEarlier states of a show kept on this device
CLEARClearing a selection, or removing an effect. It depends where you see it
SavedStored effect settings
Host / Join / Leave SessionBeing the sending device / joining one by scanning its QR code / leaving
WATCH ONLY / AllowA guest the host has not let work the light yet / the host letting it
PROVISIONALA placeholder fixture mode
GDTFA file format for fixture definitions
